text:
Pascal wrote about vanity and "doing it for the 'Gram" more than 350 years ago

why do people go on "sea voyages?"

so they can come back and talk about the sea voyage. period.

"We wish to know but to talk. Otherwise, we would not take a sea voyage in order to never talk of it."
